name: apply_note_patch
description: Apply a unified diff against a/note.adoc and b/note.adoc strictly at the expected revision; hunks must match the stored source exactly and are never fuzzed; generate the patch by saving the fetched source and the edited version byte-for-byte and running `diff -u --label a/note.adoc --label b/note.adoc current updated` (plain diff writes file names and timestamps into the header and is rejected); dry_run validates without saving; requires notes:write; warnings reject the write

inputSchema.description: 保存済み原文と変更内容のUnified Diff。厳密に適用され、位置の再探索は行われない。

dry_run.description: trueでは適用と検証まで行い、保存せずrevisionも増やさない。既定はfalse。

patch.description: `--- a/note.adoc`と`+++ b/note.adoc`のfile headerを持つ単一ファイルのUnified Diff。

inputSchema.title: McpApplyNotePatchInput

McpNotePatchOutput.description: patch適用の結果。全文は返さない。

diagnostics.description: 保存を拒否しない診断。warningがあれば適用自体が失敗として返る。

revision.description: 保存後のrevision。dry runでは保存しないためnull。
